name: forge
about: Browse a repository. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 forge/src/forge.rs:57-79,267-276 — the repository and branch pickers are PickLists with no label (unnamed ComboBoxes)
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 forge/src/components.rs:280 — file contents are a Surface: not in the tree
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 forge/src/components.rs:167-178 — a folder and a file are named alike (weight only) and fold state is only a ▸/▾ glyph label

steps.say: open the Forge tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Forge tab is selected and the forge view shows an organization label, a repositories count and a button per repository (or its empty state); no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: press the first repository in the list
steps.expect: the repository opens: an All repos button and Code, Issues and Pull requests buttons with Code checked, and a file tree of buttons named by entry

steps.say: press the first entry of the file tree
steps.expect: either the folder opens (more tree entries show) or the file opens (a Copy path button and a Read only label show)
